# Cora Studio OS — The 20-in-1 Autonomous Operating System for Creative Studios & Agencies
> Operating Entity: Cora Platforms Inc. (https://heycora.in)
> Production App: https://app.heycora.in/workspace
> System Status: https://heycora.in/status (99.98% Uptime SLA)

## Executive Summary
Cora Studio OS is the autonomous operating system engineered specifically for commercial photography studios, film production houses, wedding cinematographers, real estate brokerages, and creative agencies. Cora consolidates CRM funnels, multi-model AI agents, SHA-256 legal e-signatures, and automated 18% GST invoicing into one unified command center.

## 20 Built Platform Modules (Live in Product)
1. **Autonomous AI Co-Founder**: Multi-turn voice-to-scope, natural language execution, multi-model speed routing (Claude 3.5 Sonnet, GPT-4o, Gemini 2.0 Flash).
2. **Lead Management CRM & Kanban**: Drag-and-drop milestones, revenue forecasting, sliding deal drawer, automated WhatsApp & email outreach.
3. **Visual Canvas & Funnel Designer**: Responsive drag-and-drop landing page designer with auto-Git sync.
4. **Content AI Suite & Editorial Studio**: WYSIWYG editor, GEO-targeted SEO generator, IndexNow instant indexing.
5. **Secure Document Vault & E-Signatures**: 5-step contract wizard, touch/stylus signature canvas, SHA-256 cryptographic audit logs compliant with Indian IT Act 2000 & US ESIGN Act.
6. **Financials, Invoicing & GST Tax Hub**: 18% CGST/SGST/IGST tax engine, branded PDF invoices, payment tracking, live currency converter (INR, USD, EUR, GBP, AED, SGD).
7. **Asset & Equipment Manager**: Studio camera gear inventory check-in/out & Real estate MLS property listings catalog.
8. **Crew & Team Dispatch Scheduler**: Timeline crew dispatch grid, calendar synchronization, automated call sheet generator.
9. **Media Hub & 4K RAW Proofing**: Client galleries, 4K proofing review portals, automated watermarking.
10. **Visual Forms & Shoot Booking Engine**: Custom booking intake widgets, service add-ons, calendar slot reservation.
11. **Client Proofing & 5★ Review Portal**: Automated Google & Trustpilot review collection, star ratings.
12. **Multi-Tenant Security & RBAC**: Row-level database isolation, role-based access control (Super Admin, Studio Owner, Crew Member).
